title: Adaptive Thresholds Canvas
description: Thresholds that start at defaults and calibrate from this project's own cycle data. Added 2026-09-01, the second of seven canvases that were 'parse-checked only'. Field set taken from engine/adaptive-thresholds.md's Threshold Registry — default, calibrated, calibrated_at, based_on_n, minimum_n, bounds — rather than inferred from the entries present. WHAT A SCHEMA HERE CANNOT DO, said plainly: it can pin the SHAPE of a calibration record and cannot tell you the calibration ever ran. On the dogfood canvas every `calibrated` is null with `based_on_n: 0`, and until 2026-09-01 the file's own `_meta.calibration_status` explained that by blaming a cycle count that had in fact been exceeded. A schema would not have caught that; only reading the file against cycle-history did.

last_calibrated.description: When ANY threshold here was last calibrated. null means never.

ice_advance.description: ICE SEQUENCING REFERENCE, AND IT IS NOT AN ADVANCEMENT GATE. The name is historical. engine/adaptive-thresholds.md states it plainly: the advancement gate was REMOVED in v0.54.0 because scoring-for-selection is what Torres cautions against, and leaf-lifecycle.md Phase 5 carries the real gate — the riskiest assumption has a recorded verdict of `validated`. A validated leaf with a low ICE is DEPRIORITISED, never archived. This threshold orders what to do first; it never decides whether to do it at all. CALIBRATION INPUT: the ICE scores of leaves that were LAUNCHED AND SUCCEEDED versus those that FAILED, read from cycle-history.yml. That input was empty until 2026-09-01, when the first product-leaf cycles were recorded.

default.description: Used until calibration kicks in. A sensible starting point, not evidence.

calibrated.description: Adjusted from cycle data. null means NOT YET CALIBRATED — which is an honest state, not a gap, until based_on_n reaches minimum_n.

calibrated_at.description: When the calibrated value was set. null while calibrated is null.

based_on_n.description: How many cycles informed the calibration. 0 with a non-null `calibrated` is a contradiction: a value adjusted from nothing.

minimum_n.description: Cycles required before the calibrated value overrides the default.

bounds.description: Hard limits the calibrated value may never exceed, per engine/adaptive-thresholds.md. They exist so a small sample cannot move a threshold somewhere unreasonable.

confidence_calibration.description: Multiplier applied to stated confidence. Default assumes confidence is already calibrated, i.e. no adjustment.

evidence_staleness.description: Per-category decay horizons. THE DEFAULTS HERE MUST AGREE WITH engine/evidence-decay.md, which is the table canvas-health reads: user_needs 90, competitive 90, strategic 180, feasibility 120. Two copies of one number is how they drift, so a disagreement between this file and that table is a defect in whichever was edited last.

bakeoff_delta.description: The ICE gap below which two leaves are treated as too close to separate on score alone.
